card.name: Linking words before cancer drug terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or partial word starts (of, the, with, V, b) right before a cancer-related term such as apoptosis proteins, a leukemia drug name, or CYP enzymes. Also the space before a dose number after Administer.

modes.label: Linking word before apoptosis genes
modes.description: Of or the in a phrase about upregulation of p53 and bax in tumors.
modes.example: induced apoptosis in tumors through the upregulation<< of>> p53 and bax; it

modes.label: Start of a drug or enzyme name
modes.description: First letter of a drug name or enzyme code in interaction warnings.
modes.example: Avoid concomitant use of<< V>>ENCLEXTA with strong CYP

modes.label: Before dose after Administer
modes.description: Blank space after the word Administer, just before the leukemia induction dose.
